why.pre_refocus_block_2503_2654: USER-CONFIRMED: the lens was refocused during the 205 s pause at frames 150-152 (DSC_2652->2655). Siril per-frame registration medians: pre-block FWHM 2.944 px / roundness 0.7802 / 695 stars over 149 frames vs post-block 2.680 px / 0.7935 / 703 stars over 130 frames. A defocus consistent across 152 contiguous frames is unreachable by per-pixel rejection, so it excludes by block rather than blending its PSF into the sharp frames. The same pause re-aimed the camera ~1.2 deg RA / +0.16 deg Dec, so the exclusion additionally removes the pointing discontinuity and restores a single drift swath for min-framing.
why.2712: single-frame background spike 1283.9 ADU vs 1231 set median (+4%), nstars 632 vs 703.
why.2774: vibration hit: FWHM 3.579 px, roundness 0.7197, nstars 383 vs 703 median.
why.2711_kept: flagged bg 1236.5 vs 1231 median (+0.4%) — inside the noise of a tight distribution, not a defect.
why.weight_null: wFWHM weighting stays off: with the pre-refocus block excluded the remaining frames are a single tight focus population, the regime where Siril's min-max -weight ramp is worse than none.
why.flat: This set spans TWO pointings, so its flat is built from the post-refocus block alone (build_sky_flat --select): the all-frames flat measured a left-right corner ratio of 1.162 against 1.032 on a same-night, same-optics single-pointing set, while the top-bottom (optical) term was identical at 1.143 vs 1.142 — the divergence is sky on the drift axis. The all-frames flat is preserved as skyflat_set-01_282all.fit.
